annotations.title: Value of UIT, UVT or UMA tax units

description: Return the official value of an annual tax unit (UIT Peru, UVT Colombia, UMA Mexico) for a date, with its legal act, and convert N units to local currency. Use it when a fine, fee or tax threshold is stated in these units. For Chile's UTM use cl_indicadores. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /latam/unidades-tributarias via x402.

fecha.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; default today. Dates without an official value return an error.

pais.description: Country, as an alternative to unidad.

periodo.description: UMA only: daily (default), monthly or annual value.
